website_summary.name: Dream Homes Real Estate Portal
website_summary.description: The website offers a sleek and user-friendly interface designed with an elegant layout to showcase and manage property listings effectively.
website_summary.appearance: The website is named "Dream Homes" and features a clean, organized layout with a header containing the site's title and a navigation bar for filters and property searches. Properties are displayed in a grid format with thumbnails of the property, price, location, and characteristic icons for bedrooms, baths, parking, and area. The color theme is set with an Alice Blue background, and all interactive elements and text utilize a Steel Blue color. The properties are sorted by price in ascending order, starting from the least expensive.
website_summary.functionality: The website provides a search bar at the top for users to look up specific properties. It also includes a filter button that likely allows custom filtering of properties based on various criteria. When users click on a "View Details" button for a property, they are directed to more detailed information about that property. Users can also click a favorite button on each property, suggesting the ability to save or mark properties for later reference.
